newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-TUIGAMALA TO PLAY FOR WESTERN SAMOA AGAINST IRELAND.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TUIGAMALA TO PLAY FOR WESTERN SAMOA AGAINST IRELAND.

text.p: Former New Zealand winger Va'aiga Tuigamala is to play for his native Western Samoa against Ireland in Dublin next Tuesday.

Tuigamala, on a four-month contract with English division one side Wasps, will resume his international rugby union career on the wing where he won 19 caps for the All Blacks before switching to rugby league club Wigan.
The 27-year-old Samoan has been released by Wasps for the match following an approach from the Samoan management earlier this week. He is due to return to Wigan in January.
Tuigamala was in Western Samoa's rugby league World Cup squad last year, but has not played union for three years.
